transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?
I'm seeking help because I've been feeling extremely depressed and empty for about a month now. I feel completely drained of energy and just can't seem to function.
Have these symptoms been present nearly every day for most of the day, and did they start after a specific stressful event or life change?
Yes, I've been feeling this way pretty much every single day recently. As for a trigger, I'm really not sure because I don't think any specific stressful event or life change brought this on.
Have you felt depressed or down for most days for at least two years, or is this the first time you've had symptoms like this?
No, it definitely hasn't been going on for two years. I've only been feeling this depressed and down for about a month now. Before this past month, I didn't feel this way at all.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy, like hobbies, socializing, or work?

Yes, I've completely lost interest in almost everything I used to enjoy, including my hobbies and my work. I've also been avoiding my friends and withdrawing from socializing because I just don't get any pleasure or joy out of it anymore.
Have you also had changes in sleep or appetite, such as sleeping much more or less than usual, or eating much more or less than usual?
I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my sleep or appetite. They both seem relatively normal to me right now.
Has this been causing significant problems in your daily life, like work, school, relationships, or self-care, and did it begin within three months of a clear stressful event or change?

I haven't really noticed any specific stressful event or change that could have triggered this. But it has definitely been causing major problems in my daily life and work, because I have absolutely no energy or motivation to get anything done.
Have you been feeling guilty, worthless, or like a failure most days recently?
No, I don't really feel guilty or like a failure. It's more that I just feel extremely tired, empty, and sad all the time.
Have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or ending my life. Even though I feel really empty and sad, I don't want to harm myself at all.
Have you been having trouble concentrating or making decisions most days recently?
No, I haven't particularly noticed any trouble with concentrating or making decisions lately. My mind seems to be focusing okay despite how tired and empty I feel.
Did your symptoms begin within three months of a clear stressful event or change, even if it seemed minor?
No, I really can't recall any specific stressful event or major life change around that time. Everything in my life was pretty normal before this started, so it seemed to come out of nowhere.
